# AMEVA-Sentinel Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Privacy-First 0-Data Browser Observability & Deterministic 0~100 Threat Scoring SDK
Delivers zero-data privacy protection with deterministic 0~100 threat scoring computed entirely on the client, verified across major browser engines with zero external telemetry leakage.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: 
- Command: npm install ameva-sentinel
# or via CDN script:
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ameva-sentinel/dist/sentinel.min.js"></script>
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-sentinel

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Zero-Data Privacy Boundary**: Never collects keystrokes, passwords, or PII. Evaluates only structural browser signals.
- **Deterministic 0~100 Scoring**: Deterministic weighted rule engine calculating objective risk levels without opaque black-box AI.
- **Cross-Engine Compatibility**: Tested across Chromium, Gecko, and WebKit with zero layout shift and sub-1ms evaluation.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
# Sentinel is a Browser & Node.js Web Observability SDK.
# For Python backends, verify JWT tokens signed by Sentinel client:
import jwt
claims = jwt.decode(sentinel_token, secret_key, algorithms=["HS256"])
print(f"Verified Client Risk Score: {claims['risk_score']}")

```
